summary: Live QA passed synchronized three-object halo, Layers, primary-handle, and count-badge feedback at 100% and 125%, including collapsed sidebars; enhanced-outline minimum visibility; M/Left-Control guidance; Restore defaults; reload persistence; clean Save/Undo state; zero-extent line feedback; and an error-free console. Final npm run check passes 384 tests, typecheck, and build. The browser driver cannot emit physical KeyboardEvent.code ControlLeft, so one real owner gesture remains the sole completion gate.
evidence: Three selected connection lines produced three halos, three aria-pressed Layers rows, one primary handle set, and a visible 3 objects selected badge.
The same feedback remained synchronized at 125% with both sidebars collapsed.
Enhanced outlines off retained minimal halos; M and Restore-default copy/state were synchronized.
Browser logs contained no warnings or errors.
